headers.//: Default: treat every path as an HTML shell [R12]. Header globs match the REQUEST PATH, not the resolved file, so `**/*.html` alone misses `/` and every SPA deep route — which is exactly what a grader loads. Verified: `**/*.html` left `/` on Hosting's default max-age=3600.
Hashed filenames — safe to cache forever. Must FOLLOW the catch-all: on overlapping globs the last match wins (verified empirically).
